Figure 2. Compound 6 attenuated the CuSO4-induced inflammatory response in zebrafish. (A) Zebrafish mortality following treatment with
compound 6 at 14 concentrations. (B) Live imaging of enhanced green fluorescent protein (EGFP)-labeled immune cells in zebrafish. The red
arrows highlight the immune cells that have migrated toward the zebrafish’s lateral line, in response to the inflammatory reaction triggered by
CuSO4. (C) Quantification of immune cell migration to the lateral line region (outlined in blue). ####P < 0.0001 vs control; ****P < 0.0001 vs
CuSO4.
